extraction.notes: Single reconciliation on Attachment 2 (seq 10, printed page 3), three months ended June 30, 2023 column. ffo_total is the labeled basic FFO subtotal (221,812). The Series E convertible preferred distribution (1,222) sits between basic and diluted FFO in the printed table; to reach the diluted FFO as Adjusted subtotal (216,117) it is included as the first core adjustment with category 'other'. Without it, the core adjustments sum to -5,695 only when this line is included; the printed 'Total impact of adjustments to FFO' (-6,917) excludes it. 'Legal and other' printed as '-' for 2Q 2023, recorded as 0. Diluted FFO per share: 223,034/353,730 = 0.63; FFO as Adjusted 216,117/353,730 = 0.61; AFFO 194,772/353,730 = 0.55, all consistent. Starting net income (346,323) is attributable to common stockholders and differs from the Attachment 15 NOI table figure for net income attributable to UDR, Inc. (347,545); the Attachment 2 figure was used. Recurring capex is already deducted in AFFO so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
